grammar.0.note: These are general tendencies and do not define any individual. Every person and family is different. The aim of knowing a culture is to understand, not to judge.
grammar.1.note: sollte / könnte / wäre / würde + infinitive — polite and soft.
grammar.2.note: In a misunderstanding, calmly asking questions and repeating in your own words are good methods.
